metadata.Name: MTOP
metadata.Description: A multilingual semantic parsing benchmark for task-oriented assistants in six languages (EN, DE, ES, FR, HI, TH). It contains over 100k anonymized user queries annotated by professional linguists with intents and slots, extending the English-only TOP dataset.
metadata.Paper Title: MTOP: A Comprehensive Multilingual Task-Oriented Semantic Parsing Benchmark
metadata.Venue Title: Proceedings of the 2020 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP)
metadata.Venue Name: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
metadata.Abstract: We present the Multilingual Task-Oriented-Parsing (MTOP) dataset, a comprehensive semantic parsing benchmark for task-oriented assistants in six languages. This dataset extends the English-only TOP dataset (Gupta et al., 2018) and features a substantially larger and more comprehensive set of domains, intents, and slots. The dataset is annotated by professional linguists on real-world, anonymized user queries. It contains over 100k utterances in English, German, Spanish, French, Hindi, and Thai, with a near-parallel translation of the English data in the other five languages. We provide two different representations of the annotations: a 'flat' representation that is simple and easy to parse, and a 'compositional' one that is more expressive. We establish strong baselines for both representations using state-of-the-art multilingual pre-trained models. Our results show that while we achieve strong performance for English, there is a significant gap in performance for other languages, especially in a zero-shot setting. We also show that using a language-agnostic representation of the output can improve zero-shot performance. The dataset is available at https://github.com/google-research-datasets/mtop.
